test_title: PYST 45: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 02 Sept, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All oranges are melons.

All grapes are oranges.

Conclusions:

(I) Some melons are oranges.

(II) All grapes are melons.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

Conclusions:

(I) Some melons are oranges.- True ('All oranges are melons.Some oranges are melons, and some melons are oranges this is true)

(II) All grapes are melons.- True (All grapes are oranges.All orange are melons. Hence, it is True)

Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
